name: Moshi 'Chottoare' na Joshi Manager ga Druck*r no 'Management' poi Mono o Yondara.
original_name: もし「ちょっとアレ」な女子マネージャーがドラッ◯ーの「マネジメント」ぽいモノを読んだら。
source:
Hinata was a slightly risky student secretly dating the captain of the baseball team, a team she also happened to manage. 

One day Hinata decided to improve her management and the overall success of her team with some self-help book. But while shopping online she ended up on a site about "How To Run A Sex Shop"...
